webhooks.lockdownWarning: A critical or security update is required (v{{version}} available).
webhooks.lockdownDescription: Creating, editing, pausing, rotating secrets or deleting webhooks is locked until the app is updated. Test deliveries still work.
webhooks.aboutBody: BioPlatform posts JSON to your endpoint whenever an event you subscribe to fires. Each request includes a signature in the <0>X-BioPlatform-Signature</0> header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your signing secret) so you can verify it came from us. Failed deliveries are retried up to 5 times with increasing backoff. Max 10 webhooks per account. Discord webhook URLs (channel → Integrations → Webhooks) are supported automatically — deliveries are sent as a formatted embed so Discord shows the event nicely instead of raw JSON.

data.aboutBody: Export your profile as a generic spreadsheet (single sheet, one field per row) that you can open anywhere — Excel, LibreOffice, Google Sheets, or Notepad. Imports accept .xlsx, .ods, and .csv files. Macro-enabled files (.xlsm, .xls) are rejected. Unknown rows are skipped and listed as warnings. Importing replaces your current profile fields.

discord.connectBody: Connect with Discord to show your presence (online status, current activity, and what you're listening to) on your public profile and in shared link previews. Your connection uses the official Discord API and is opt-in — you control what is shown. Presence is tracked by an instance bot, so you must also be in a server that shares the bot.

discord.postBody: Set a Discord webhook URL to add a "Post to Discord" action. Posting sends your profile card image (banner, avatar, name, bio, badges) with a short title to your channel. The embed is kept in sync: posting again — or editing your profile — updates the same message instead of spamming your channel, and switching webhooks removes the old message. Webhooks are stored encrypted. Live presence is not baked into the card (Discord caches images), so your current song/status never looks stale.

PRO: Enterprise-only features become locked: business SSO, team seats and the enterprise webhooks API.
Limits change to 3 profiles, 5 aliases and 5 music tracks.
Custom domains stay enabled (Premium keeps them).
FREE: Premium-only features become locked: custom domains, advanced analytics, Discord integration, data export and the webhooks API.
Limits change to 1 profile, 0 aliases, 2 music tracks and 3 shop products.
Existing profiles, aliases, tracks and products are kept — they just can't grow past the new limits.
